uncertainty_scope: Per-seed, per-scene 95% Wilson intervals describe finite test episode sampling conditional on a fixed trained policy and the stated evaluation distribution. Training-seed means, ranges and sample standard deviations are descriptive; three seeds do not establish general training reliability. Episodes from different trained policies are not pooled. Intervals do not change acceptance gates.
